content:
Eva: QA reported two small regressions after the density token patch: (1) compact buttonsfocus rings are clipped; (2) save toasts sometimes appear under the sticky table header on phones.

Marco: Repro'd on iPhone 12. Outline is clipped because row uses overflow:hidden. Quick option: switch to `:focus-visible` + box-shadow fallback for compact buttons.

Jules: Prefer to keep native outline where possible for AT users. Proposal: component token `--compact-focus-offset: 3px` and use that only for compact variant so we dont mutate global tokens. If still clipped, fall back to `box-shadow`.

a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure focus indicator meets 3:1 contrast and test in high contrast mode.

Eva: For toasts, move them into the top-level overlay root appended to body and use fixed positioning with safe-area inset. That avoids stacking contexts from sticky headers.

Marco: I'll open two tiny PRs: one for `--compact-focus-offset` + `:focus-visible` rules, one to mount toasts to `#overlay-root` (body) with z-index above sticky headers.

Jules: I'll add the accessibility notes to the component docs and include `prefers-reduced-motion` for the spinner.

Eva: Thanks team. Small regressions, fast fixes. Please include visual snapshots in PRs.
